SELECT result_date, SUM(result_count) AS result_count FROM ( SELECT
TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{search_date}, 'yyyy-MM') + (LEVEL - 1), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS result_date, 0 AS result_count
TO_CHAR(LEVEL) AS result_date, 0 AS result_count
TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{year} || '-01', 'yyyy-MM'), LEVEL - 1), 'yyyy-MM') AS result_date, 0 AS result_count
FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(#{search_date}, 'yyyy-MM')), 'dd') 7 12 UNION ALL SELECT
TO_CHAR(access_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS result_date, COUNT(*) as result_count
TO_CHAR(access_date, 'd') AS result_date, COUNT(*) AS result_count
TO_CHAR(access_date, 'yyyy-MM') AS result_date, COUNT(*) AS result_count
FROM ARCHIVE_STATISTICS
) GROUP BY result_date ORDER BY result_date
